spans.s:
इषणय, nom. (from the next) A., Ved. इष-
णयते, -यितुम्, to move, excite.

1. इषणि, इस्, f., Ved. impulse, desire. (For 2. see
under 3. इष्.)

2. इषणि, इस्, f., Ved. wish, desire. (For 1. see
under 1. इष्.)

इषण्य, nom. P., Ved. इषण्यति, -यितुम्, to
cause to make haste, to excite, drive.

इषव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. इषु below), Ved. skilled
in archery.

इष, अस्, m. one who possesses sap and strength;
[]
the month Āśvina (September-October); strength,
vigour (?).
—इष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. vigorous.
—इष-स्तुत्, त्, m., Ved. a praiser of the desired
(Sun); (त्), f. praise of comfort.

ईश, अस्, आ, अम्, owning, possessing, sharing; one
who is completely master of anything; capable of
(with gen.); powerful, supreme; a ruler, a master,
a lord; (अस्), m. a husband; a Rudra; the number
‘eleven’ (as there are eleven Rudras); N. of Śiva
as regent of the north-east quarter; (आ), f. faculty,
power, dominion.
—ईश-त्व, अम्, n. supremacy, supe-
riority.
—ईश-सखि, आ, m. Śiva's friend, an epithet of
Kuvera.
—ईशाध्याय (˚श-अध्˚), अस्, m., N. of the
Īśa-upaniṣad.
—ईशोपनिषद् (˚श-उप्˚), त्, f., N. of
an Upaniṣad.

ईष ईष, अस्, m. the month Āśvina; see
इष; a son of the third Manu; a servant of Śiva.

ईषा ईषा, f. (said to be fr. ईष्), the pole or
the shafts of a carriage or plough; (ए), du. the double
or fork-shaped pole.
—ईषा-दण्ड, अस्, m. the handle
of a plough.
—ईषा-दन्त, अस्, m. an elephant with
a large tusk or tooth, the tusk of an elephant.
—ईषाधार (˚षा-आध्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.

ईशान, अस्, आ, अम्, owning, possessing, wealthy;
reigning; (अस्), m. a ruler, master, one of the older
names of Śiva-Rudra; one of the Rudras; the sun
as a form of Śiva; a Sādhya; epithet of Viṣṇu; N.
of a man; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā; (अस् or ई), m.
or f. the silk-cotton tree, Bombax Heptaphyllum;
(अम्), n. light, splendor.
—ईशान-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
acting like a competent person, making use of one's
possessions or faculties; (Sāy.) rendering one a master
or able.
—ईशान-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a physician.
—ईशान-ज, आस्, m. pl. a class of deities forming a
section of the Kalpa-bhavas.
—ईशान-देवी, f., N. of a
woman.
ईषण, अस्, आ, अम्, hastening; (आ), f. haste.

ईषत् ईषत्, ind. (said to be a pres. part. fr.
rt. ईष्), little, a little, slightly.
—ईषच्-छ्वास, अस्, आ,
अम्, slightly resounding.
—ईषज्-जल, अम्, n. shallow
water, a little water.
—ईषत्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, doing
little; easy to be accomplished.
—ईषत्-कार्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, connected with slight effort.
—ईषत्-पाण्डु,
उस्, m. a pale or light brown colour.
—ईषत्-पान,
अस्, आ, अम्, that of which a little is drunk; (अम्),
n. a little draught.
—ईषत्-पुरुष, अस्, m. a mean
man.
—ईषत्-प्रलम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gained
for little.
—ईषत्-स्पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, slightly touched
(applied to the semivowels).
—ईषद्-उष्ण, अस्, आ,
अम्, tepid, slightly warm.
—ईषद्-ऊन, अस्, आ, अम्,
not quite complete or entire.
—ईषद्-गुण, अस्, आ,
अम्, of little merit.
—ईषद्-दर्शन, अम्, n. a glance,
a slight inspection.
—ईषद्-धास (ईषत्-हास), अस्,
m. slight laughter, a smile.
—ईषद्-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
pale red.
—ईषद्-विवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, slightly open.
—ईषन्-नाद, अस्, आ, अम्, slightly sounding (applied
to unaspirated soft consonants).
—ईषन्-निमय, अस्,
आ, अम्, exchanged for a little.
—ईषल्-लभ, अस्, आ,
अम्, to be obtained for a little.
